description: Hard-case physiological falsification with pre-registered kill/win thresholds. Compartmental model with actual eShunt anatomy (inferior petrosal sinus).

pre_registered_thresholds.kill: ΔAUROC(B-A) < 0.02 with CI excluding meaningful benefit
pre_registered_thresholds.counterfactual_kill: If C (periventricular) helps but B (eShunt) doesn't → COMPARTMENT_IDENTITY_FAILURE

hard_case_design.class_overlap: Normal physiological excursions can mimic obstruction (random ±3-4 mmHg events)
hard_case_design.parameter_uncertainty: starling_gain Uniform(0.4, 0.95), peri_coupling Uniform(0.05, 0.45), nonlinear Starling
hard_case_design.eShunt_anatomy: Inferior petrosal sinus (IPS) — per CereVasc published anatomy

kill_reason: eShunt differential provides no incremental benefit (ΔAUROC=+0.0000, CI=[+0.0000, +0.0000]). No compartment provides advantage over absolute ICP.
